title: Phone app: a Stop button for spoken readouts, and new builds pushed to the phone from the laptop

fields.why: TJ cannot stop an audio readout on the Android app, and wants app updates shipped remotely like Nightmare Mode does

text: Phone app is in mobile/ (android, bridge, relay; see mobile/DESIGN.md). 1) Add a visible Stop control that halts text-to-speech mid-readout. 2) Copy the pattern of ~/nightmaremode/game/tools/ship_android.sh: build the APK, upload a zip-tested snapshot to a Cloudflare R2 bucket at a stable secret URL (secret in a home-dir file, not the repo) with a small download page, so TJ installs updates from the phone. Goal: phone-app.

fields.user_said: and yes work on those fixes

text: While the phone reads a reply aloud, a Stop button is visible on the Talk screen; tapping it silences speech at once and drops queued replies, without turning read-aloud off; the button disappears when speech ends
check: eye: on the phone, start a readout, tap Stop, speech halts, speaker toggle still on

text: mobile/ship_android.sh builds the APK, uploads a zip-tested snapshot plus a download page to R2 under a secret path read from a file in the home folder (never in the repo), and checks the online size matches
The download page at the stable URL serves and links an APK that installs on the phone
check: manual: curl the page and APK; install from the phone

text: Each shipped build has a higher versionCode, so Android installs it over the old one

evidence: JAVA_HOME=~/dev-tools/jdk17 ./gradlew assembleDebug -> BUILD ok, app-debug.apk 16482255 bytes, 2026-11-08 11:57
build.gradle.kts versionCode = minutes since 2026-01-01; output-metadata.json shows versionCode 448856 (was 1), versionName 0.1.448856

text: Shipping the debug APK keeps the same signing key (~/.android/debug.keystore on this laptop) as the build already on the phone
breaks: If the phone build was signed elsewhere, Android refuses the update until the old app is uninstalled (pairing lost)

text: Stop: ReadingBar above the tabs while TTS queue non-empty (UtteranceProgressListener), hush() stops + clears queue, read-aloud stays on.
